description: Use this when someone wants to contact the provider of a listing (anfragen, Kontakt aufnehmen, Besichtigung anfragen, contacter l'agence, contattare): sends the enquiry in their name. Needs their name, e-mail and a short message (phone optional). Works for Heimster listings and «found:<id>» agency-website listings (forwarded to the agency). If the person is signed in to Heimster it is sent at once; otherwise Heimster e-mails a confirmation link first.

language.description: Language of titles, descriptions and links (default de). Use the user's language.

name: send_enquiry
title: Send an enquiry
